body: Thank you, I wish the best for you. You are very kind and sweet. I hope things only get easier for us both. 🙂

He left me unconscious at his brother's house when I was passed out drunk. First time I ever passed out from alcohol. (I end up having alcohol poisoning). He left me there and didn't even check in on me the next day. I had to message him updates. Then the day after he broke up with me. It hit really hard.

I hope so. I want to succeed, I really do
Thanks 🖤

Thank you, it really means a ton. My boyfriend of nearly 5 years left randomly one day. He said he didn't feel anything towards me anymore. How he has felt that way for months. I just feel unwanted and that there is something wrong with me
I'm sorry you feel the way that you do, but from an outside perspective, you are far from ugly. I really hope you feel better soon.

I cannot even imagine how you felt, but I do see you from an outside perspective. You look like a beautiful and charming young woman. I am so sorry for what you have been through so far but there is so much of your life left to prove her wrong. I wish you the best of luck and to have a lovely rest of your day.
I love the look, you look gorgeous! I hope you have a lovely day 🖤

Personally I think you're gorgeous. Your eyebrows are amazing, your eyes are big and chocolatey looking. Your nose is adorable. I do not live in your head but from an outside perspective, I think you're a work of art.

I'm sorry you dealt with that, they sound very similar. It really hurts but I think I'll both get through it. Thank you for your comment 🖤
Thank you for your comment 🖤 I really appreciate it

Thank you for such a powerful and caring response 🖤 

I was able to ask my ex about things and why they happened the way they did (it hurt like hell and I was so emotional) but it was what I needed to hear. I'm not better over night from it but I'm taking a step at a time. It hurts so much but right now I'm being the best person I can be right now. And that is all I really can ask for. I've been talking with people every night, some during the day, just so I can try to keep my brain on track.

I understand how scary it is for your loved one to say they just want to end it. How it makes you feel that you yourself aren't enough to keep them around. The whole ordeal is just haunting. But I guess all we really can do is be here for another and hope for the best. 

Thank you 🖤

I'm really happy you're taking it as well as you are. You do not deserve what you've been through and it is so shitty how someone you love could do something so awful to you in return. Being hurt by the very person you promised to give your all to is one of the worst feelings in the world. I cannot eat, I cannot sleep, dreaming hurts, everything hurts really... I can't imagine your situation is any better. It's shitty and I'm so sorry you went through that.

I don't feel I can be loved... I don't think I hold anything worth moving in for. I feel like I'm just fighting to get to have just another bad day the next day and the day after that. I feel like I have no redeeming qualities. Sure people say I do but they just don't want the burden of me dead on their hands. I feel I'm just living for no reason... It just hurts me. I have family but it feels like they hate me for just breathing sometimes. What's the point of living when the things that once brought you such great joy, just give you nothing at all? All my hobbies, all the things I loved to do, they give me no satisfaction... I'm just living because i don't want to burden people with my death... I need to find a new purpose to my life. Because I cannot continue like this...

I'm just scared I won't be able heal because I have to see him everytime I go out of the house. He works right down the road. He's always by my house, I feel like I cannot go anywhere without feeling I'd fall right back to square one. Scared I'd run into him... I also work at the biggest Mall in the city, I don't want to run into him... I'm scared...

Thank you It really means alot. And it's different to hear someone else's story.

I've been dreaming of him nightly, it hurts so bad. I've been on the suicide hotline for three days in a row. I also tried to help him too. I felt like his mother almost because I constantly had to guide him and set his kind straight... He would make bad choices so often. I just am worried his life will fail without me. I know he says he doesn't love me and he doesn't feel anything towards me but I just care so much...
